'''Pietra's grandmother''' is a minor character who appeared in ''[[SP10|The Grand Rhydon Plan]]''.

==In the manga==
She was first seen in the cave when [[Pietra]] took {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} there. Later, after Pietra caught a {{p|Rhydon}} for her tunnel project, she took her grandmother to a nearby town and celebrated with Ash and his friends after the project was complete.

==In animation==
Pietra's grandmother was only mentioned in ''[[EP204|Right On, Rhydon!]]'' when Pietra mentioned that she needed to complete a tunnel for her grandma to have access to a nearby town.
